# MIT News

> MIT News delivers comprehensive coverage of cutting-edge research, innovation, and achievements across MIT's schools, departments, and world-renowned research centers.

MIT News serves as the central news hub for Massachusetts Institute of Technology, featuring research announcements, faculty achievements, and institutional developments across all academic disciplines. The site aggregates content from MIT's schools of engineering, architecture and planning, and specialized research centers including Lincoln Laboratory, Media Lab, and MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Energy Storage & Sustainability
- Neuroscience & Brain Research
- Quantum Computing
- Generative AI & Large Language Models
- Aerospace & Astronautics
- Biotechnology
- Technology Innovation
- Climate Change Research
- Policy & International Relations
- Design & Urban Planning
- Startups & Entrepreneurship
- Faculty Research
- Educational Programs
- MIT Schwarzman College of Computing

## Core Navigation

- [MIT News Homepage](https://news.mit.edu): MIT News homepage featuring latest research, innovation, and achievements from MIT community.
- [Topics Directory](https://news.mit.edu/topics): Directory of news topics and research areas organized by subject at MIT News.
- [Departments Directory](https://news.mit.edu/departments): Directory of MIT departments and academic programs at MIT News.
- [Centers, Labs, and Programs Directory](https://news.mit.edu/centers-labs-programs): Directory of MIT research centers, labs, and programs at MIT News.

## Research Topics

- [Machine Learning](https://news.mit.edu/topic/machine-learning): MIT News coverage of machine learning, AI research, and large language models.
- [Sustainability](https://news.mit.edu/topic/sustainability): MIT News on sustainability, renewable energy, and climate change research.
- [Black Holes & Astrophysics](https://news.mit.edu/topic/black-holes): MIT News on black hole research, gravitational waves, and astrophysics discoveries.
- [Startups & Entrepreneurship](https://news.mit.edu/topic/startups): MIT News coverage of student ventures, faculty spinouts, and startup innovation.

## Schools & Academic Programs

- [School of Engineering](https://news.mit.edu/school/engineering): MIT News from School of Engineering on research, AI, and biotechnology.
- [School of Architecture + Planning](https://news.mit.edu/school/architecture-and-planning): MIT News from School of Architecture and Planning on design and research.
- [Classes and Programs](https://news.mit.edu/topic/classes-and-programs): MIT News on classes, degree programs, and educational initiatives.

## Departments

- [Aeronautics and Astronautics](https://news.mit.edu/department/aeronautics-and-astronautics): MIT News from Aeronautics and Astronautics department on aerospace research.
- [Brain and Cognitive Sciences](https://news.mit.edu/department/brain-and-cognitive-sciences): MIT News from Brain and Cognitive Sciences on neuroscience and brain research.
- [Mechanical Engineering](https://news.mit.edu/department/mechanical-engineering): MIT News from Mechanical Engineering on energy storage and innovation.
- [Architecture](https://news.mit.edu/department/architecture): MIT News from Architecture on sustainable design and urban planning research.
- [Political Science](https://news.mit.edu/department/political-science): MIT News from Political Science on international relations and policy research.

## Research Centers & Institutes

- [Lincoln Laboratory](https://news.mit.edu/clp/lincoln-laboratory): MIT News from Lincoln Laboratory on quantum computing and satellite technology.
- [Media Lab](https://news.mit.edu/clp/media-lab): MIT News from Media Lab on technology innovation and sensing systems.
- [Picower Institute for Learning and Memory](https://news.mit.edu/clp/picower-institute): MIT News from Picower Institute on brain disorders and neuroscience research.
- [Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab (J-PAL)](https://news.mit.edu/clp/abdul-latif-jameel-poverty-action-lab-j-pal): MIT News on J-PAL poverty research, policy evaluation, and AI innovation.
